odd_even_process_pairs.even_uncertainty_reduced: Decisively reduced. The 'momentum edge' is an artifact of a degenerate always-long signal, not a momentum anomaly; a correctly-specified short-horizon momentum signal has no zero-cost edge, so momentum cost robustness is moot; the prior candidate positive momentum evidence is invalidated. Also established that a genuine momentum signal would carry ~0.4 turnover (material cost sensitivity), so any future momentum test must be re-run after fixing the signal, and that reuse-based verifiers (importing momentum_signals) cannot catch such a defect.
